I am Akili, the assistant in this app. I can open pages, run actions, and work with your own data and settings here.

Things I can do:

- **Counter** (this page): increment or decrement the demo counter.
- **Profile** ([Profile](/Profile)): view or update your display name and time zone.
- **Settings** ([Settings](/Settings)): add a passkey or link a Microsoft 365 account.
- **Feedback** ([Feedback](/Feedback)): file a bug, feature request, complaint, or other note, and review what you have already filed.
- **Agent Links** ([AgentLinks](/AgentLinks)): open the page where you manage agent links.
- **Sign out** of this browser session.

If you have admin access, I can also open [Roles](/Admin/Roles), [Principals](/Admin/Principals), [Feedback Admin](/Admin/Feedback), [Authentication](/Admin/Authentication), and [AI](/Admin/AI) (assistant name and whose xAI key Ask uses).

Demo and developer pages are available too, including [Weather Forecasts](/WeatherForecasts), [Superheros](/Superheros), and [Chat](/Chat).

Tell me what you want to do, or I can take you to a page.

A 401 on `feedback.submit` means the call is not authenticated. That operation only runs for a signed-in person, so a script has to send that session’s credentials. Missing or invalid auth is what produces 401, not a bad payload.

The body also has to include `kind` (`Bug`, `FeatureRequest`, `Complaint`, or `Other`), `title`, and `body`.

Sign-in is managed on [Settings](/Settings). You can file from [Feedback](/Feedback), or I can submit it for you here. I can open either page if you want.
